items.name: SKYPE
items.epitaph: The call that made distance feel free finally went quiet.
items.why: Microsoft retired the consumer service to focus its free communication products on Teams.
items.afterlife: Its ringtone, usernames, chat histories, and role in normalising internet calls remain part of online culture.
items.note: Skype launched in 2003 and Microsoft retired the consumer service on 5 May 2025; Skype for Business is separate.
items.image_alt: Monochrome museum illustration of a desktop video call setup with webcam and headset
